variants.specifics: Brackenford: Halvard wants the tithe chest back from Red Corwin's bandits; Sly Wat, a turncoat, wants an ale for what he knows of Corwin's tower.

offer_a.speaker: Halvard
offer_a.text:
Greetings, brave Adventurer! This town has been robbed blind in a shameless bandit raid!

Will you please bring back the tithe chest Red Corwin's men stole? If you do, you shall be well paid, because the good Brothers of the Chapel of the Ford cannot eat without it!

offer_b.speaker: Sly Wat
offer_b.text: You, again. Will you think it over, buy me an ale and hear what I know about Corwin's tower?

outcome_a.speaker: Halvard
outcome_a.text:
It's done, then! The tithe chest is safe in the Moot Hall again!

Take this shield, though. You have more than earned it!

Corwin's men still hold the watchtower, but I hear one of those filthy bandits drinks at the Drowned Lantern. If you ask around there maybe you can find a way in!

outcome_b.speaker: Sly Wat
outcome_b.text: Shame to hear that. I hope you think again soon, for I fear Corwin's lads are getting wise to me. I saw one of them sniffing around the inn a short while back.

journal_a.text: Recover the tithe chest stolen by Red Corwin's bandits.

journal_b.text: Buy Sly Wat an ale at the Drowned Lantern.

variants.specifics: Dolgar: Warden Ostrel posts a bounty on Snade the Claim-Jumper, dead or alive; Pibble the gem-trader, robbed by Snade's gang, wants them brought in.

offer_a.speaker: Ostrel
offer_a.text:
Good day, lad. I presume you've come about the notice.

There's a fat purse for Snade the Claim-Jumper -- dead or alive. He and his rotten crew have been robbing our ore carts for some time now.

Watch yourself, you'd hate to be ambushed by those mangy dogs.

offer_b.speaker: Pibble
offer_b.text:
Actually, trade has been pretty poor lately. Last month, those claim-jumpers broke in and cleaned out my stall.

I don't suppose I'll get my gems back, but nothing would make me happier than to see those crooks get what's coming to them.

I'll gladly pay whoever brings them in.

outcome_a.speaker: Ostrel
outcome_a.text:
Snade's dead, eh? Well, I'd wanted him alive for the gallows, but I won't be shedding any tears for him!

Here's your bounty -- 150 in gold! Dolgar is a safer town thanks to you!

outcome_b.speaker: Pibble
outcome_b.text:
So the claim-jumpers have got what they deserved! Good work, lad! We'll all rest easier knowing those crooks won't be sticking their greedy fingers in our pockets!

And here's your reward... a fine steel shield! Pibble's stall is always open to you!

journal_a.text: Bring in Snade the Claim-Jumper, dead or alive.

journal_b.text: Bring Snade's gang of claim-jumpers to justice for Pibble.

variants.writer: Claude Agent SDK subagent, Claude Opus 5.5

variants.specifics: Pellmire: Warden Ossel posts a bounty on Grelk the Smuggler, dead or alive. Grelk, cornered, surrenders.

offer_a.speaker: Warden Ossel
offer_a.text:
Good day, stranger. I presume you've come about the notice.

There's a fat reward for Grelk the Smuggler -- dead or alive. He and his miserable crew of cutthroats have been robbing our toll boats for a month.

Mind yourself, you don't want a knife in the back from that wretched lot.

offer_b.speaker: Grelk
offer_b.text: Enough! I give up! Don't hit me, please! I'll come along quietly!

outcome_a.speaker: Warden Ossel
outcome_a.text:
Hey, there! Elsbet told me of a terrible racket down this way, so I came to have a look.

You have caught the infamous Grelk the Smuggler all on your own! Most impressive! You have my highest regard! Grelk's crew has plagued Pellmire for a month! I'll handle him now. We'll all rest easier with this rotten villain in the stocks!

And here is your reward -- 200 in gold!

outcome_b.speaker: Warden Ossel
outcome_b.text:
You did away with Grelk, eh? Well, I'd wanted him in the stocks, but I won't shed any tears over the rascal!

Here's your reward -- 100 in gold! Thank you for ridding Pellmire of that pest!

journal_a.text: Bring in Grelk the Smuggler, dead or alive, for Warden Ossel.

journal_b.text: Escort Grelk the Smuggler to Warden Ossel.

variants.specifics: Korlen: Paymaster Orvel wants the garrison's pay chest back from Gruttock's Ogres; Sergeant Gorlick wants to sell his stripes and his post at the gate.

offer_a.speaker: Orvel
offer_a.text: Truthfully, the men's spirits have sunk pretty low, with Gruttock's Ogres on the prowl. They carried off the garrison's pay chest and I want it back.

offer_b.speaker: Gorlick
offer_b.text: You ready to take over my stripes and my post at the gate? Just 30,000 gold pieces for the lot!

outcome_a.speaker: Orvel
outcome_a.text: Wonderful! You've earned this Chain Tunic, lad! I hope you live through this whole war. Now if you'll excuse me, I've a garrison of hungry soldiers to pay. Good luck and keep clear of Gruttock's Ogres if you want to keep your head!

outcome_b.speaker: Gorlick
outcome_b.text: Eh, no harm done, lad. I'm certain some young recruit will snap up my stripes and my post. If you think it over though, I'm always at the Broken Pike!

journal_a.text: Recover the garrison's pay chest from Gruttock's Ogres.

journal_b.text: Buy Sergeant Gorlick's stripes and post at the gate.

variants.specifics: Ondel: Bastok the Harbor Master lends boats only to those a fisherman vouches for, and Grubbin the eel seller will vouch if the player kills the Leech in his eel pond.

offer_a.speaker: Bastok
offer_a.text: I am the Harbor Master of Ondel. If you want a boat out on the lake you'll need a fisherman to vouch for you.

offer_b.speaker: Grubbin
offer_b.text:
Hiya. Grubbin's the name, best eel man in all of Ondel. The lake is deadly these days and getting a boat off old Bastok is even worse.

Look here, if you do me a little job I'll vouch for you myself. How about it?

outcome_a.speaker: Grubbin
outcome_a.text:
Good! I keep the fattest eels in Ondel in a pond behind my shack. Trouble is, a great slimy Leech has crawled into the pond. It has riled up the frogs and now they jump on anybody who comes near.

Kill the Leech and when you get back, I'll vouch for you with Bastok.

Here, take this brass key, it opens the gate to my pond.

outcome_b.speaker: Grubbin
outcome_b.text:
Suit yourself, but I don't reckon anybody else will vouch for you.

If you think better of it I'll be at the Rusty Hook next to the docks.

journal_a.text: Find someone in Ondel to vouch for you with Bastok.

journal_b.text: Kill the Leech in Grubbin's eel pond.

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Odalie's little brother Tobble was carried off by Trolls from the herb gardens; the apprentice Jessop lost his master's best hat to the same Trolls.

offer_a.speaker: Odalie
offer_a.text:
Sir! Please, help me! A band of ugly Trolls just stormed the herb gardens, south of the College and carried off nearly every one of the young students! One of them is my little brother, Tobble!

Please bring him home safe and you shall be rewarded!

offer_b.speaker: Jessop
offer_b.text:
The Trolls just ran off with my master's best hat! If he finds it gone, he'll have my hide. He's due home any time now!

Please, help me, stranger! I saw them carry it off toward the mill pond.

Would you... could you bring it back for me?

outcome_a.speaker: Odalie
outcome_a.text: Bless you, kind sir! Please, take these as tokens of my gratitude!

outcome_b.speaker: Jessop
outcome_b.text: Oh, thank you, stranger! Here, take this as a token of my appreciation!

journal_a.text: Rescue Tobble from the Trolls and bring him home to Odalie.

journal_b.text: Get Jessop's master's hat back from the Trolls.

variants.specifics: Fort Skarra: Gimble sells a used Steel Shield on the cheap. Sergeant Kolb says anyone on wall watch needs a shield and sends the player to Brakka's forge.

offer_a.speaker: Gimble
offer_a.text:
Now here's a real beauty of a shield. The last owner mostly used it as a sled.

Down at Brakka's forge, one like this would run you 250 gold or more. But seeing as I like you, I'll let you have it for 90. You want it?

offer_b.speaker: Kolb
offer_b.text: Anyone standing watch on the wall needs a shield of his own. Brakka's forge sells them at an honest price.

outcome_a.speaker: Gimble
outcome_a.text: Sold! That shield's got your name on it. Nothing's getting past you on the wall with that.

outcome_b.speaker: Gimble
outcome_b.text: Big mistake, friend. Go on down to Brakka's and have a look at his prices. Then hurry on back -- another buyer's been sniffing around it.

journal_a.text: Buy the used shield from Gimble.

journal_b.text: Buy a shield at Brakka's forge for wall duty.

variants.specifics: Vurn: Kragg the armorer sells a chain tunic fitting for 100 gold, Pibble wants his furnace chain pulled on his signal.

offer_a.speaker: Kragg
offer_a.text: Ready to be fitted for a chain tunic? I'll want 100 gold for the iron.

offer_b.speaker: Pibble
offer_b.text:
Hey, you there. Could you yank that iron chain by the furnace when I wave my cap? I'd be ever so grateful.

Hold on, let me get out of the way first.

outcome_a.speaker: Kragg
outcome_a.text: Hmmm, a shame. Not everyone can afford proper armor.

outcome_b.speaker: Pibble
outcome_b.text: It roared! I can't believe it roared! Thank you! You're my lucky charm!

journal_a.text: Buy a chain tunic from Kragg the armorer.

journal_b.text: Pull Pibble's furnace chain when he gives the signal.

variants.specifics: Varrow: Master-at-Arms Varnus sells a place in the town watch with its sword and mail; Fennick, once one of Krull's men, sells boots in the Gilded Boar.

offer_a.speaker: Varnus
offer_a.text:
Greetings. I am Master-at-Arms Varnus. And it was Druvan who sent you, eh? Well, the town watch can always use another blade, but the sword and mail will cost you 50 in gold.

Do you agree to my terms?

offer_b.speaker: Fennick
offer_b.text:
Hail, Wanderer! Could I interest you in some fine boots to wear on your travels? These boots are the same as Krull's scouts wear and worth every bit of the 150 gold I'm asking.

Ya want 'em?

outcome_a.speaker: Varnus
outcome_a.text: Very well! This sword is from the watch's own armory. The tunic is good iron chain, which will turn most bandit arrows.

outcome_b.speaker: Fennick
outcome_b.text:
There you go, I'm sure those boots will carry you far.

Come find me again if you ever need another pair.

journal_a.text: Pay Master-at-Arms Varnus to join the watch of Varrow.

journal_b.text: Buy a pair of boots from Fennick at the Gilded Boar.

variants.specifics: Tolm: Tamm sits in the lockup at the Town Hall and offers a way into Krog Durm. Hulda needs him back at her cider press for the harvest.

offer_a.speaker: Tamm
offer_a.text: Hello there. Folks call me Tamm. Can you spring me from this lockup? Do that, and I'll show you a way into Krog Durm.

offer_b.speaker: Hulda
offer_b.text:
Oh, for pity's sake! Tamm's in the lockup again?! Sometimes I think he gets caught on purpose just to dodge his chores. It's hard work running a cider press, you know. The whole apple crop is coming in today and I need Tamm at the press when the carts pull up.

Tell you what... Spring Tamm from the lockup and you can have one of the chain tunics the peddler owes me!

outcome_a.speaker: Tamm
outcome_a.text: Thank you for getting me out. Take this gold as token of my thanks. Oh, I nearly forgot! Here's a key to the back gate of Krog Durm. Mind yourself in there. The Ogres won't take kindly to a stranger sneaking round their fort. Thanks again!

outcome_b.speaker: Hulda
outcome_b.text: Tamm! What were you thinking, getting yourself locked up on harvest day? Thanks for springing him, stranger! Here's the chain tunic, like I said. Good luck with whatever it is you're up to!

journal_a.text: Get Tamm out of the lockup in the Town Hall.

journal_b.text: Free Tamm and return him to Hulda's cider press.
